notes.title: Prepare for an intergalactic battle spectacle in 2026!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello BVN enthusiasts! 

We promised you an intergalactic battle spectacle, and we have been diligently working towards this goal. But great things take time - so we’ve decided to move [b][u]our release date to 2026[/u][/b] to bring you the best game possible. 

Please look forward to what’s in store leading up to the release, as we have exciting updates that we can’t spill the beans on just yet, but when we do… get ready to GET HYPED!!! 

In the meantime, [b]head to [url="https://discord.gg/yk6hBhpfvw"][u]our Discord[/u][/url][/b] for questions, discussions, and any theory-crafting you might desire. You will be able to chat with other likeminded folk about our other games (shout out to Grindstone)! 

We appreciate and thank you for your patience. It means so much to us whenever we see your enthusiasm for the game. 

Talk to you again soon! 

💙 Capybara Games aka CAPY![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050973/e949ab91a7a0f2c0df3e6d76206e528847a4c013.png"][/img][/p]
